name: hvalec-site
description: Orchestrates three independent frontend projects (main/, karl/, admin/) into one shared dist/. Each project builds and can be worked on entirely on its own — this just assembles them.

scripts.build: npm run build:main:production && npm run build:karl && npm run build:admin && npm run finalize
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:main:staging && npm run build:karl && npm run build:admin && npm run finalize
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:main:dev && npm run build:karl && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:main:production: cd main && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build --config _config.yml,_config_production.yml
scripts.build:main:staging: cd main && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build --config _config.yml,_config_staging.yml
scripts.build:main:dev: cd main && bundle install && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.build:karl: cd karl && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist/karl && cp -R karl/dist/. dist/karl/
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p dist/admin && cp -R admin/dist/. dist/admin/
